title: 桃園機場捷運~Taoyuan Airport MRT
focus: 機場快慢車混跑與行李轉乘介面~Airport express commuter mixing and baggage interfaces
summary: 以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。~Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 catch_time=1248 s；單元 2 得 equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons；單元 3 得 dwell=25.02083 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 gap 的擾動測試，結果改為 1372.8 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives catch_time=1248 s; unit 2 gives equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons; unit 3 gives dwell=25.02083 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing gap in the first unit changes its result to 1372.8 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2017 年：桃園機場捷運於三月正式通車營運；2025 年：IEC 發布新版鐵道 RAMS 第一部分通用程序。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2017: Taoyuan Airport MRT opened for commercial service in March; 2025: IEC published the revised railway RAMS Part 1 generic process. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.title: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.mechanism: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 比較快車追上慢車的時刻與可用待避路徑。~Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Compare the time when an express catches a commuter train with available passing routes.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13728 m，其餘固定，結果為 1372.8 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1372.8 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.
units.verify: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。~Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation.
units.failure: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。~Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.
units.misconception: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量~Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
units.practice: 增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 行李旅客與等效交換需求~Luggage and effective passenger exchange
units.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求~Luggage and effective passenger exchange
units.mechanism: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 依門口交換負荷建立攜行李旅客的等效係數，與一般旅客分開計數。~Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Define baggage-passenger equivalents for doorway exchange load and count them separately from ordinary passengers.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers.
units.verify: 匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。 分別計數一般旅客與行李旅客，以實測交換時間或占用面積校準係數，保留用途與區間。~Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour. Count ordinary and baggage passengers separately, calibrate the factor against exchange time or occupied area, and retain its purpose and range.
units.failure: 行李集中在少數車門會使全列停站時間由局部控制；同樣人數但不同分布可能造成完全不同的交換效率。 相同人數可能有不同負荷，需保留行李比例而非只報總人數。~Luggage clustering at a few doors can control whole-train dwell; the same passenger total with a different distribution can have very different exchange efficiency. Equal headcounts can impose different loads; retain baggage proportions rather than reporting total people only.
units.misconception: 機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求~Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
units.practice: 比較集中行李區與分散行李區的等效需求，提出無障礙與一般旅客都可使用的導引方式，並列出需要實測校準的係數。 再以本單元 luggage 的對照值重算 equivalent_demand，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare concentrated and distributed luggage areas, propose guidance usable by passengers with different access needs, and list coefficients requiring measurement-based calibration. Also recalculate equivalent_demand for the alternative luggage value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 用行李占用車門附近空間的情境檢查最慢門組。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Test the slowest door group when baggage occupies space beside the train doors.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 275至 275 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.32292 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 275, to 275 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.32292 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把航廈步行、電扶梯與候車拆成可獨立量測的轉乘區段。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Split terminal walking, escalator travel and waiting into separately measurable transfer stages.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 m，其餘固定，結果為 49.08 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.08 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.mechanism: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 讓終端折返與單程時間共同決定最少上線車組數。~Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Use both terminal turnaround and one-way running time to estimate the minimum circulating fleet.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.
units.verify: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。~Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.
units.failure: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。~Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.
units.misconception: 車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定~Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
units.practice: 增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 區分機場站停準目標與防護用速度監督曲線。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Separate the airport stopping target from the protective speed-supervision curve.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=25.6 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=427.2 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 28.16 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 533.0658 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=25.6 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=427.2 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.16 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 533.0658 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 在共享供電區段中測試快慢車同時加速的壓降。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Test voltage drop when express and commuter trains accelerate in the same supply section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1560 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=93.6 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1716 A，其餘固定，結果為 102.96 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1560 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=93.6 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1716 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 102.96 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 用不同停站頻率比較理想可回收能量與網路可接受能量。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare ideal recoverable energy and network receptivity under different stopping patterns.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 274560 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.49167 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 274560 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.49167 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.title: 到站變異與平均等候~Arrival variability and mean waiting
units.mechanism: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 以相同平均班距但不同波動估算機場旅客的隨機到站等候。~With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Estimate random-arrival waiting for airport passengers with equal mean headway but different variability.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s；計算：wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s。敏感度：mean 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s，其餘固定，結果為 111.7013 s。模型邊界：獨立隨機旅客到達、穩態班距且皆可登車；不含時刻表配合到站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mean=187.2 s; sd=60 s; calculation: wait=(mean**2+sd**2)/(2*mean)=103.2154 s. Sensitivity: mean, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 111.7013 s. Model boundary: Random independent passenger arrivals, stationary headways and no denied boarding; timetable-aware arrivals are excluded.
units.verify: 從連續到站紀錄計算班距平均與變異數，再用匿名旅客到站時刻重播等待，檢查是否存在容量不足或非隨機到站。 從逐列到站時間重建班距平均與標準差，將旅客隨機到達事件重播，核對等候樣本平均。~Calculate headway mean and variance from consecutive arrivals, replay waiting with anonymous passenger arrival times, and check for capacity limits or nonrandom arrivals. Reconstruct mean and standard deviation from successive train arrivals, replay random passenger arrivals, and compare the sampled mean waiting time.
units.failure: 只報平均班距會低估不規則服務的等待；旅客配合時刻表到站時又不能直接套用隨機到站公式。 若滿載造成無法上車，需額外追蹤留下隊列而不能沿用公式。~Reporting only mean headway understates waiting under irregular service, while timetable-aware arrivals invalidate the random-arrival formula. When full trains prevent boarding, track the remaining queue separately instead of reusing this formula.
units.misconception: 兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間~Two services with equal mean headway necessarily have equal mean passenger waiting time.
units.practice: 保持平均班距不變，把標準差減半後重算等待，並用一組確定性到站時間說明公式假設何時失效。 再以本單元 mean 的對照值重算 wait，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Hold mean headway fixed and halve its standard deviation, recalculate waiting, then use deterministic arrivals to show when the formula assumptions fail. Also recalculate wait for the alternative mean value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把旅客服務可用性與單一設備可用性分開定義。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Define passenger-service availability separately from the availability of one item of equipment.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1372.8 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970947 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1372.8 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970947 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：2017 年，桃園機場捷運於三月正式通車營運。~Verified background: 2017, Taoyuan Airport MRT opened for commercial service in March.

教學假設，單元 2：luggage=62 persons，計算 equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: luggage=62 persons, calculated equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：exchange=250 persons，計算 dwell=25.02083 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: exchange=250 persons, calculated dwell=25.02083 s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：distance=187.2 m，計算 margin=67.8 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: distance=187.2 m, calculated margin=67.8 s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 5：cycle=5616 s，計算 fleet=32 trains；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 5: cycle=5616 s, calculated fleet=32 trains; not measured performance.
